domainContract.truthOwnershipRule: A truth key may have exactly one canonical domain owner.
domainContract.dependencyRule: Dependencies must reference registered domains and the graph must remain acyclic.
domainContract.boundaryRule: Cross-domain calls must consume a declared authority/contract rather than reaching into another domain's private implementation.

domains.name: Identity & Access
domains.purpose: Authenticate human/system actors and decide access from canonical identity and role authority.
boundaryRules: Authorization decisions must derive from server-owned identity/role authority.
Identity may expose actor and authorization context, but may not silently select a tenant.
Client-editable metadata is never an authorization authority.

domains.name: Tenant & Operating Context
domains.purpose: Resolve the active webshop/tenant and operating context before tenant-scoped capability selection.
boundaryRules: Tenant context must be explicit; first-tenant/null-to-default fallback is forbidden.
Cross-tenant access requires platform authority and an explicit target tenant.
Tenant context must be resolved before tenant-scoped mutation or capability selection.
Signed pilot acceptance tenant selection is tenancy/context authority even when the implementation file is consumed by storefront and commerce preview flows.

domains.name: Commerce Core
domains.purpose: Own canonical transactional commerce decisions and shared deterministic commerce decision/read-model contracts without allowing presentation or client state to become business truth.
responsibilities: deterministic product discovery and structured comparison read models
non-authoritative decision-support intents that require server revalidation before mutation
boundaryRules: Client-submitted prices and totals are untrusted and must be recalculated from canonical data.
Order and payment state transitions must be explicit and idempotency-aware.
Provider-specific payment behavior must enter through integration contracts.
Deterministic discovery, comparison, configurator and composer engines may emit read models or intents, but they may not mutate price, inventory, cart, customer or order authority directly.

domains.name: Catalog & Inventory
domains.purpose: Own sellable product identity, variants, availability and inventory truth.
boundaryRules: Presentation may display stock/product data but may not invent availability.
Inventory mutations must be tenant-scoped and transactionally consistent.
Commerce consumes catalog/inventory truth through stable contracts.

domains.name: Content & Editorial
domains.purpose: Own tenant-scoped CMS/editorial content lifecycle and validated story/provenance read models. Storefront and templates consume this authority but may not invent or override editorial truth.
responsibilities: editorial story validation and read models
boundaryRules: Storefront and templates may render content authority outputs but may not become a second editorial persistence or provenance authority.
Unverified provenance relations and unsafe arbitrary markup or URLs fail closed rather than being presented as validated editorial truth.
Template switching may change page drafts/presentation but may not mutate canonical story/content documents by implication.

domains.name: Storefront Runtime & Presentation
domains.purpose: Render shopper-facing experiences by composing canonical platform capabilities without becoming a second business authority.
boundaryRules: Storefront consumes shared capabilities; it may not duplicate auth/account/commerce/support engines.
Responsive behavior follows canonical viewport/workspace authority rather than host heuristics.
Template presentation may vary while business capability authority remains shared.
Storefront-prefixed shared runtime modules remain storefront authority even when physically located under builder component/lib directories.
Otherwise-unowned shopper-facing App Router page modules and the public sitemap metadata fall back to Storefront presentation authority; any explicit canonical domain match takes precedence.

Public customer-account App Router pages under src/app/fiokom/** are Storefront presentation authority; customer identity, membership and commerce truth remain owned by their canonical domain authorities.

domains.name: Builder & Template System
domains.purpose: Own authored page/template structures and deterministic materialization into storefront runtime inputs.
boundaryRules: Builder output must conform to canonical Page Schema and shared Runtime contracts.
Source preset, persisted draft/package and runtime materialization are distinct states.
Blocks/presets may not introduce second authorities for shared capabilities.
Template preview and visual-fidelity QA surfaces are Builder execution surfaces; they may consume shared Storefront runtime but must not call Admin action modules directly.
Template catalog, preview, quality-candidate and AI generation orchestration are Builder authority even when their filenames begin with storefront-.
Immutable storefront preview token routes under src/app/storefront-preview/** are Builder execution surfaces; they may render shared Storefront runtime but retain Builder preview authority.

domains.name: External Integrations
domains.purpose: Isolate external providers behind stable Shoperation contracts and fail-safe transport boundaries.
boundaryRules: Core business logic must not depend on provider-specific payloads.
Callbacks/webhooks require authenticity verification and fail closed on invalid proof.
Provider outage/invalid response must not silently fabricate successful business state.

domains.name: Merchant & Platform Operations
domains.purpose: Compose governed operational capabilities for merchants and platform operators.
boundaryRules: Admin UI must call canonical domain authorities rather than mutate domain state ad hoc.
Platform and merchant scope must remain explicit and permission-aware.
Operational summaries are projections, not replacement sources of truth.

Admin orchestration may depend on canonical storefront, builder, content and integration authorities, but those dependencies must remain consumption/composition edges and may not transfer truth ownership into DOMAIN-ADMIN.

domains.name: Database, Schema & Persistence
domains.purpose: Own durable schema, transactional persistence contracts, grants and row-level isolation guarantees.
boundaryRules: Runtime assumptions about schema must be proven against target environment baseline.
RLS is mandatory for public tenant-bearing data surfaces.
Migration syntax, grants and callable symbols are part of the production contract.

domains.name: Quality Knowledge & Engineering Controls
domains.purpose: Turn architecture, known failures and development/release evidence into deterministic prevention and proof.
boundaryRules: Quality evidence must be bound to exact source/release identity.
Unknown or review-required failure intake persists until explicit disposition.
Quality controls may block invalid change but may not redefine domain truth to make tests pass.
Template Factory Known Failure and authority registries are quality knowledge even when stored beside Builder implementation.

Quality-system helper modules under scripts/lib/shoperation-** are DOMAIN-QUALITY authority and must use the same canonical Atlas classification pipeline as materialized nodes and downstream resolvers.

domains.name: Incident Intelligence & Recovery
domains.purpose: Normalize incidents, triage responsibility, correlate evidence and govern safe repair/self-healing decisions.
boundaryRules: Incident diagnosis may reference domain evidence but must not become a competing domain authority.
Automated repair requires explicit allowlisted procedure, preconditions and post-verification.
Code-changing self-heal defaults to proposal-first unless a deterministic runbook explicitly authorizes execution.

domains.name: Release & Production Lifecycle
domains.purpose: Assemble dependency-closed release transactions and prove exact production provenance.
boundaryRules: Development branch history is not automatically a valid Release Transaction.
Production requires exact-head/main provenance and target-environment proof.
Preview/staging readiness must never be labeled production.

rules.rationale: Order authority may invoke stable integration adapter contracts while provider-specific transport and payload semantics remain owned by DOMAIN-INTEGRATIONS.
Quality scope resolution reads release classification policy as configuration; it does not own release truth or mutate release state.
Template preview/proof surfaces must call a shared canonical acceptance capability rather than import Admin action modules.
Identity/admin request guards may consume canonical tenant membership and current-instance context to decide access, while tenant selection and membership truth remain owned by DOMAIN-TENANCY.
Shared Storefront runtime may consume Builder-produced template package, installation, preview and normalization contracts while Builder retains template/schema/materialization truth ownership.
